text:
Matthew Knies circled Saturday, and it showed. Back in Toronto, where the Maple Leafs drafted him 57th overall in 2021 and gave him 240 games, he scored, set up another and put five shots on goal as Columbus came from behind to win 4-3. The team's own video put it simply: "Knies Got Even." Two nights earlier in Chicago he had three points. That's 9 points in his last 10, most of them in the last two.

Through 21 games as a Blue Jacket he has 6 goals and 14 points at 18:45 a night. The finishing is honest: 6 goals on 5.5 expected (expected goals measure the quality of his chances). What's lighter than his Leafs years is the volume of looks, 0.85 expected goals per 60 against 0.94 last season, and his 5v5 shot share sits near even at 49%.

The thing to watch is his rush game. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 56% of his shots coming off the rush last season, with 18% of his setups from behind the net, more than double a typical forward. If Columbus feeds that, the last week won't be a one-off.
headline: Knies gets his night back in Toronto
